name: Yumehara Asuka
source: Tsukasa's dirt-poor classmate, permitted by the school to work part time. Very tired from working late hours along with studying, she is usually spotted sleep-walking to school and then sleeping through the lessons. Despite this, she has exceptionally good grades and a cheerful demeanor.
translation: Tsukasa's dirt-poor classmate, permitted by the school to work part time. Despite this, she has exceptionally good grades and a cheerful demeanor.
